Although you say that Palawan is closer to Malaysia, here's an historical tidbit about Sabah in Malaysia.

The 1878 Agreement: The Sultan of Sulu signed a contract with British representatives granting control over North Borneo (now Sabah).

British companies and later the Malaysian government paid an annual cession/rental sum to the heirs of the Sultan of Sulu until 2013, when Malaysia stopped the payments following a deadly armed standoff in Lahad Datu.

Sulu is a province of the Philippines in the Sulu Archipelago and part of the Zamboanga Peninsula region.
